title: ISO Valve Standards
description: An overview of ISO - International Organization for Standardization - valve standards. This tool provides a comprehensive reference for valve-related ISO standards covering various applications including safety valves, hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, fire protection, steam traps, and industrial valves.

components.content:
## ISO Valve Standards Reference

This calculator provides an overview of ISO valve standards organized by application type.

### Standard Categories:

**Safety & Pressure Protection**
- ISO 4126-1:2004 - Safety valves

**Hydraulic Systems**
- ISO 4401:1994 - Four-port directional control valves
- ISO 4411:1986 - Pressure differential/flow characteristics
- ISO 5781:2000 - Pressure-reducing and related valves
- ISO 6263:1997 - Compensated flow-control valves
- ISO 6264:1998 - Pressure-relief valves
- ISO 6403:1988 - Flow and pressure control test methods
- ISO 7368:1989 - Two-port slip-in cartridge valves
- ISO 7790:1997 - Four-port modular stack valves

**Pneumatic Systems**
- ISO 5599-1:2001 - Five-port directional control valves (without connector)
- ISO 5599-2:2001 - Five-port directional control valves (with optional connector)
- ISO 5599-3:1990 - Code system for valve functions

**Industrial Valves**
- ISO 5208:1993 - Pressure testing
- ISO 5209:1977 - Marking
- ISO 5210:1991 - Multi-turn actuator attachments
- ISO 5211:2001 - Part-turn actuator attachment
- ISO 5752:1982 - Flanged pipe systems dimensions
- ISO 5996:1984 - Cast iron gate valves
- ISO 6002:1992 - Bolted bonnet steel gate valves
- ISO 7121:1986 - Flanged steel ball valves
- ISO 10631:1994 - Metallic butterfly valves

**Fire Protection & Sprinklers**
- ISO 6182-1:2004 - Automatic sprinkler systems - sprinklers
- ISO 6182-2:1993 - Wet alarm valves and water motor alarms
- ISO 6182-3:1993 - Dry pipe valves
- ISO 6182-4:1993 - Quick-opening devices
- ISO 6182-5:1995 - Deluge valves
- ISO 10497:2004 - Fire type-testing requirements

**Steam Traps**
- ISO 6552:1980 - Definition of technical terms
- ISO 6553:1980 - Marking
- ISO 6554:1980 - Flanged steam traps dimensions
- ISO 6704:1982 - Classification
- ISO 6948:1981 - Production and performance tests
- ISO 7841:1988 - Steam loss determination

**Thermoplastic Valves**
- ISO 7508:1985 - PVC-U valves for pipes under pressure
- ISO 8233:1988 - Torque test method
- ISO 8242:1989 - Polypropylene (PP) valves
- ISO 8659:1989 - Fatigue strength test method
- ISO 9393-1:2004 - Industrial applications - pressure test methods
- ISO 9393-2:1997 - Test conditions for PE, PP, PVC-U and PVDF

**Agricultural Irrigation**
- ISO 7714:2000 - Volumetric valves
- ISO 9635:1990 - Hydraulically operated irrigation valves
- ISO 9644:1993 - Pressure losses test method
- ISO 9911:1993 - Manually operated small plastics valves
- ISO 9952:1993 - Check valves
- ISO 10522:1993 - Direct-acting pressure-regulating valves

**Other Applications**
- ISO 683-15:1992 - Heat-treatable steels for valve steels
- ISO 4422-4:1997 - PVC-U pipes and valves for water supply
- ISO 6182-1:2004 - Sprinkler systems
- ISO 7244:1984 - Air dampers and valves aerodynamic testing
- ISO 7259:1988 - Key-operated cast iron gate valves for underground use
- ISO 10418:2003 - Offshore production safety systems
- ISO 10423:2003 - Wellhead and Christmas tree equipment
- ISO 10931-4:1997 - PVDF valves for industrial applications
- ISO 10933:1997 - PE valves for gas distribution systems
- DIN ISO 7967-3:1993 - Internal combustion engine valve terminology
